items.title: Scaffold the complete local workspace
items.question: Can each development domain be inspected and coordinated without taking over its source?
criteria: Eight explicit modules, member bindings and read-only adapters.
Persistent work records, evidence links, activity, export and startup.
HTTP boundaries, stale-write handling, responsive controls and restart persistence verified.
items.nextAction: Finish the scaffold and record its technical verification.

items.title: Preregister conservative contact alternatives
items.question: What evidence would justify a different wrist or belly/leg boundary?
criteria: Pin the source scan, V2 map and measured package.
Record baseline, alternatives, invariants, measurements and rejection criteria before authoring.
Verify input hashes and save a receipt without changing production geometry.
items.nextAction: Run the contact-baseline runbook after scaffold verification.

items.title: Author one reversible contact candidate
items.question: Can a conservative declared boundary retain the scan's visible volume and produce coherent limb patches?
criteria: Exact face IDs and source provenance for every changed assignment.
Matched textured, clay, torso-only and isolated-limb views.
No source geometry removal to improve a graph; uncertainty stays explicit.
items.nextAction: Choose one contact and author a separately saved diagnostic candidate under the protocol.

items.title: Review static identity before standing
items.question: Does the same scanned teddy remain recognizable in a coherent anatomical assembly?
criteria: Independent visual challenge against the original scan.
Source-visible belly, arms, asymmetry and paw shapes retained.
M1 decision recorded with unknowns; no automatic approval from measurements.
items.nextAction: Review the exact saved candidate and record supported, contradicted and unresolved observations.

items.title: Rebuild standing pose and restrained shuffle
items.question: Can the accepted static interpretation deform without losing scan identity?
criteria: 21-joint schema retained; bind and motion recomputed if joints move.
Exact exported pose, one step and loop checked for collapse, penetration and sliding.
Matched Studio and native views; technical and visual gates separate.
items.nextAction: Proceed only after the static interpretation is reviewed.

items.title: Re-establish the chamber candidate baseline
items.question: Which saved chamber revision and current locks govern the next art pass?
criteria: Confirm candidate branch, dirty files and lock-holder coordination.
Capture the actual saved map and exact settings before editing.
Compare front, reverse and ordinary gameplay views to selected references.
items.nextAction: Coordinate the candidate writer and create a fresh baseline receipt.

items.title: Refine chamber light and fractured-floor read
items.question: Which bounded art change reduces the largest measured reference gap?
criteria: Change one cause at a time with matched native cameras.
Preserve combat routes, controls and camera cutaway.
Keep original and rejected candidates; save visual findings and runtime checks.
items.nextAction: Select a single lighting or material hypothesis from the fresh baseline.

items.title: Validate the complete encounter loop
items.question: Does the saved game remain playable through win, loss and restart?
criteria: Use a fresh scoped native run and exact saved revision.
Exercise movement, aim, fire, dodge, pause, restart and endings.
Distinguish injected input, physical-device testing, audio and performance.
items.nextAction: Schedule one owned native runtime session after the workspace scaffold.

items.title: Establish scan dimensions and missing coverage
items.question: Can measured bear-only scale and hidden contact evidence be obtained?
criteria: Retain UNKNOWN until an actual measurement or source observation exists.
Keep original support geometry distinguishable from the bear.
Record provenance and coverage limitations for new input.
items.nextAction: Obtain a bear-only measurement or additional source photographs when available.

items.title: Plan audio, performance and packaging verification
items.question: Which delivery claims remain untested in an ordinary game session?
criteria: Separate audio audition, physical controls, sustained timing and packaged startup.
Use actual target hardware and name the tested build.
Do not reuse a silent short capture as audio or performance evidence.
items.nextAction: Create bounded validation runs after encounter and character integration.

items.title: Connect the first game experiment to the review loop
items.question: Does a real game deliverable produce inspectable workspace evidence?
criteria: Experiment protocol and receipt resolve by catalogued identity.
Work record names its exact evidence and limitations.
Activity persists across refresh and exports with the work state.
items.nextAction: Record GAME-001 and its receipt through the persistent work journal.

items.title: Add future member adapters through contracts
items.question: Can a new tool or repository join without broad filesystem access?
criteria: Explicit member binding, source contract and health meaning.
Offline/missing/changed states remain distinguishable.
No credentials or arbitrary executable commands in browser payloads.
items.nextAction: Add only adapters required by the next game deliverable.

items.title: Optimize the workspace for LLM-assisted building
items.question: Can a coding agent acquire bounded context, coordinate scope and return a verifiable handoff?
criteria: Model-neutral CLI and human Agent build view share task contracts.
Bounded context preserves mandatory instructions and source hashes.
Conflicting reservations, source drift, out-of-scope outputs and false acceptance claims are rejected.
Save behavioral and browser verification with exact limitations.
items.nextAction: Verify the agent workflow and prepare the next game assignment.

items.title: PR1: merge grok/chamber-parity-continuation into main
items.question: Can grok 0a20f9f land on main 3a1d254 through a reviewed PR without overwriting work?
criteria: PR head 0a20f9f, base 3a1d254; merge-tree clean, README the only overlap.
No binary changed on both sides; merge commit, no --admin or force.
TeddyEncounter.umap LFS lock released after merge; remaining locks unchanged.
items.nextAction: Open the PR, merge when GitHub reports it mergeable, then release the map lock.

items.title: Back up the CP refinement and FloorV2 to a branch
items.question: Is the uncommitted chamber refinement and FloorV2 preserved before any merge?
criteria: Commit the CP worktree's dirty files and FloorV2 to a backup branch; main untouched.
Lock holders confirmed; the FloorV2 lock gap recorded.
Branch pushed and its commit SHA recorded.
items.nextAction: Coordinate with the CP worktree writer, then create and push the backup branch.

items.title: PR2: CP 244534d into main, TeddyChamberParity kept alongside
items.question: Can the chamber candidate merge without replacing TeddyEncounter?
criteria: PR head 244534d after PR1; TeddyChamberParity stays a separate map.
TeddyEncounter unchanged; merge-tree clean against the merged main.
QA smoke of both maps recorded with the commit SHA.
items.nextAction: Re-run merge-tree against the merged main and open the PR.

items.title: PR3: bear-scanner work and workspace into main
items.question: Can the bear-scanner work, including the federated workspace, land after Codex commits it?
criteria: Codex has committed all its work, including workspace/ and tools/federated_workspace/; workspace/local stays untracked.
Only the expected WORK_STATUS.md conflict; untracked binary folders resolved or locked.
Workspace tests pass on main.
items.nextAction: Wait for the Codex work to be committed, then open the PR.

items.title: PR4: map and game-mode config plus packaging
items.question: Does a packaged build start in TeddyEncounter with BP_EncounterGameMode?
criteria: DefaultEngine.ini default map and game mode set to TeddyEncounter / BP_EncounterGameMode; DefaultGame.ini ProjectName fixed.
Packaged Win64 build starts and completes the encounter loop.
Build commit SHA and hardware named in the receipt.
items.nextAction: Prepare the config diff once PR1 and PR2 are on main.

items.title: Write the locked encounter spec into ENCOUNTER.md
items.question: Does ENCOUNTER.md state the verified live values?
criteria: Every S value carries Tech's verdict: confirmed, as authored or corrected.
Corrections applied: fire 0.33 s pulse, dodge ~2500 cm/s and ~350 cm, front bound 100 cm tall, full control map.
Proposed values stay marked as proposed.
items.nextAction: Merge the draft locked spec into ENCOUNTER.md once PR1, PR2 and PR4 are on main.

items.title: Boss half-health escalation
items.question: Does the boss escalate at half health as Design specifies? Approved by Luther on 8 Oct.
criteria: Phase 2 starts at 144 HP, on the 13th rifle hit.
Retime the strike: AttackLeft peaks at ~0.67 s versus the 0.92 s strike timer.
Phase-2 cycle of 1.72 s fits the 1.8 s Attack clip.
Stitchlings are a boss copy and keep the 1.15 s recovery.
Built via the Grok CLI: headless grok in its own --worktree, session ID recorded in the handoff; LFS lock on BP_TeddyBoss.
items.nextAction: Design finalises the escalation spec; Tech then runs the build via the Grok CLI in its own --worktree and records the session ID.

items.title: QA gate B1-B10 for Milestone 1
items.question: Does the merged Milestone 1 build pass QA's gate?
criteria: B1 encounter keys 12/12.
B2 edges 13/13 plus v2: strike radius 475, telegraph 0.92+/-0.05 s, cooldown 0.8+/-0.05 s, i-frames.
B3 parity runtime 48/48.
B4a full room on TeddyEncounter 28/28.
B4b full room on TeddyChamberParity via TEDDY_CHAMBER_MAP 28/28 (935 cm).
B4c chamber runtime on TeddyEncounter 34/34.
B5 no soft-locks.
B6 AI paths within 10 s: boss reaches 380 cm or closes 700 cm; stitchling reaches 190 cm or closes 350 cm; stuck <20 cm over 3 s fails; no overlap.
B7 audio audition.
B8 perf at 1080p on Latrine: p95 <=8.3 ms, no hitch >33.3 ms outside F5, reload <=3 s, memory growth <=10%, t.MaxFPS 0, VSync off.
B9 real keyboard and mouse.
B10 PR2 suites: team rig 89/89, scanned bears pass, importer contract 3/3, bear_studio 21/21.
Every receipt carries the commit SHA.
items.nextAction: Run the gate against the merged main once PR1, PR2 and PR4 land.
